about_short_description.short_description: Idemeum is an Endpoint Protection Platform

product.name: Idemeum Privileged Access Management
product.description: Automates the creation, rotation, and management of individual admin accounts for technicians, enabling secure access to customer cloud applications.

product.name: Just-in-time Entra ID access
product.description: Automatically creates and manages individual Entra ID admin accounts for technicians, enabling and disabling accounts as needed for secure access.

product.name: Automatic password rotation
product.description: Automatically changes passwords for accounts, enforcing strong, random passwords to enhance security.

product.name: Audit logs
product.description: Captures detailed logs of access requests and activities, maintaining them in the cloud for security and compliance.

product.name: Zero-knowledge cloud LAPS
product.description: Securely stores emergency computer accounts in the cloud, automatically rotates passwords, and controls access with zero-knowledge encryption.

product.name: Passwordless MFA
product.description: Allows login and elevation with biometrics, eliminating the need for passwords or shared MFA codes through FIDO2 technology.
